name: JsonFix
tagline: 一键修复脏JSON，让数据清洗零门槛
description: 专注于自动修复缺失引号、尾逗号等常见语法错误的极简在线工具。支持批量处理与一键复制，专为开发者从LLM或老旧API获取残缺数据场景优化。
core_features: 智能语法修复（自动补全引号/括号）
value_proposition: 比在线JSON格式化器更懂'脏数据'，无需安装本地依赖即可在浏览器端瞬间修复LLM生成的错误JSON，解决开发者手动调试的痛苦。
monetization_hint: 免费版限次，Pro版提供API接入、更大批量限制及团队共享空间

github_repos.description: Fast, developer-friendly JS/TS dependency vulnerability scanner with local lockfile scanning, OSV matching, direct vs transitive visibility, --fix, JSON output, and practical remediation guidance.
A package.json file scrubber for the truly insane.
JSON Fixer for Humans using (relaxed) JSON5
Repair JSON! A Java library for fixing JSON anomalies generated by LLMs.
the json validator that actually tells you how to fix your mistakes
